name: REST API Style Guide Coverage Rubric
description: Evaluates the topic coverage of an API style guide. Checks whether all essential REST API design topics are addressed with sufficient depth.

metadata.author: systemspec-apistyle
metadata.purpose: Assess completeness of API style guides across 26 REST API design categories

categories.name: Fundamentals Coverage
categories.description: Core REST API design fundamentals that every style guide must address.
categories.evaluationPrompt: Evaluate whether this API style guide covers the fundamental REST API design topics.

topics.name: General Guidelines
topics.description: API-first principles, design philosophy, fundamental requirements

topics.name: Naming Conventions
topics.description: Property naming (camelCase/snake_case), resource naming, identifier format

topics.name: URL Design
topics.description: Path structure, query parameters, URL casing, resource hierarchy

topics.name: HTTP Methods
topics.description: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE semantics and idempotency

topics.name: HTTP Status Codes
topics.description: Status code selection, success vs error codes, standard codes

passCriteria: Covers all 5 fundamental topics with at least 2 rules each
partialCriteria: Missing either naming or HTTP method guidance
failCriteria: Missing critical topics like naming or HTTP methods

categories.name: Request/Response Coverage
categories.description: How requests and responses are structured and handled.
categories.evaluationPrompt: Evaluate coverage of request and response handling patterns.

topics.name: Request & Response Bodies
topics.description: Content types, body structure, required fields

topics.name: HTTP Headers
topics.description: Standard headers, custom headers, content negotiation

topics.name: Error Handling
topics.description: Error format (RFC 7807), error codes, error messages

topics.name: JSON Conventions
topics.description: Date formats, null handling, enums, nested objects

topics.name: Schema Design
topics.description: Type definitions, required properties, validation

partialCriteria: Error handling covered but format not specified

categories.name: Collections & Querying
categories.description: How to handle collections, pagination, filtering, and sorting.
categories.evaluationPrompt: Evaluate coverage of collection operations and querying.

topics.name: Pagination
topics.description: Cursor vs offset, page size, next/prev links

topics.name: Filtering & Sorting
topics.description: Filter syntax, sort parameters, field selection

topics.name: Collection Resources
topics.description: Collection response format, metadata, bulk operations

partialCriteria: Pagination covered but approach not specified

categories.name: API Lifecycle
categories.description: How APIs evolve, version, deprecate, and maintain compatibility.
categories.evaluationPrompt: Evaluate coverage of API lifecycle management.

topics.name: Versioning
topics.description: Version format, version location (URL/header), version policy

topics.name: Backward Compatibility
topics.description: Breaking vs non-breaking changes, additive changes

topics.name: Deprecation
topics.description: Deprecation process, sunset headers, migration guidance

categories.name: Security Coverage
categories.description: Authentication, authorization, and security best practices.

topics.name: Security
topics.description: Authentication methods, authorization, HTTPS, security headers

categories.name: Documentation Requirements
categories.description: What must be documented in API specifications.

topics.name: Documentation
topics.description: Required descriptions, examples, OpenAPI requirements

categories.name: Advanced Patterns
categories.description: Advanced API patterns beyond basic CRUD operations.
categories.evaluationPrompt: Evaluate coverage of advanced API patterns.

topics.name: Long-Running Operations
topics.description: Async operations, polling, status endpoints

topics.name: Conditional Requests
topics.description: ETags, If-Match, optimistic concurrency

topics.name: Batch Operations
topics.description: Bulk create/update/delete, batch request format

topics.name: Actions & Functions
topics.description: Non-CRUD operations, custom actions

categories.name: Ecosystem Integration
categories.evaluationPrompt: Evaluate coverage of ecosystem and integration patterns.

topics.name: Events & Webhooks
topics.description: Event format, webhook delivery, CloudEvents

topics.name: Hypermedia/HATEOAS
topics.description: Link relations, discoverability, self links

topics.name: Performance
topics.description: Caching, compression, rate limiting

topics.name: Rate Limiting
topics.description: Rate limit headers, 429 handling, quotas

adequate.description: Covers essentials but missing advanced topics
